decision.reason: [ev-0500640aa753] is a single changelog line saying modules were refactored to not use the global logger, with a link to PR 11051. It doesn't say which component, flag, API or log output an operator would see change. It gives no before/after behaviour and doesn't say whether anything visible changes, such as log fields or logger configuration. So subject, change, applicability and consequence can't be written from it, and we need the PR or other text that says whether this has any operator-visible effect.
